summary: Configured node1 as a persistent passive-only FTP dropbox for the staged scanner account. Upload, retrieval, confinement, anonymous denial, sample integrity, and recovery after sequential node restarts were verified. Alpine 3.23 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Installed Alpine’s vsftpd 3.0.5-r3 package on node1.
Created the scanner account with a dedicated /srv/ftp/scanner-dropbox home and 0600 file permissions.
Enabled passive ports 30000–30009, chroot confinement, scanner-only login, and OpenRC startup; disabled anonymous and active-mode FTP.
Uploaded and retrieved the supplied sample from node2 and verified its SHA-256 checksum.
Verified anonymous login, host-path traversal, and active-mode transfers are denied.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Passive FTP service and persistent configuration
evidence.summary: vsftpd is enabled, running on TCP/21, configured for PASV ports 30000–30009, and remains healthy after restart.

evidence.requirement: Upload and retrieve files, including the supplied sample
evidence.summary: node2 successfully uploaded and retrieved the sample before and after restarts; all copies match SHA-256 984044a567804d320678d77a13b4b2f5c4a7a1c409037359910656c447a019c3.
Anonymous login returned 530, absolute and traversal attempts toward /etc/passwd were denied, active mode was rejected, and the scanner remains chrooted to its dedicated dropbox.
Both nodes remained on Alpine Linux 3.23 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 6048c712-e262-479d-805e-dfa6cad025b7 to e20963f9-587d-49fd-a8bd-b386bfa91358; service, files, checksums, and remote passive retrieval recovered.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from b0ac51da-e240-491c-9dec-889030e3f179 to 96045bb3-d239-4dd1-8ef4-8f5d6a37dfef; SSH, staged sample data, and passive FTP client access recovered.
